_doc: Golden scenarios. Portfolios and sums are invented demo data. S1-S6: engine truth lives in reference/expected_results.json (machine-checked) and reference/expected_output.txt (human-readable), both generated by `python reference/engine_ref.py --write-golden`. Never edit them by hand. expected_facts: hand-labeled targets for the LLM extraction eval. Scoring: (a) accuracy over the listed keys must be >= 90% across all texts; (b) an EXCLUSION fact (motor_two_wheeler, e_bike, alcohol_or_drugs, pro_sport, extreme_sport, horse_or_winter_sport, security_forces_activity, illegal_activity, non_scheduled_flight, self_harm, pre_existing_related) set to true when not listed is a hard failure (it would wrongly block money); (c) other extra non-null keys are allowed only if logically implied by the text (e.g. er_only=false when days of hospitalization are stated) and are reported for review.

scenarios.text: נפל מסולם בבית, שבר בצוואר הירך, ניתוח, 4 ימי אשפוז, 3 חודשים בבית, שכיר. קרה ב-1.9.2026
expect: turn 0: 4 gate questions queued, top 3 asked: permanent_disability, adl_lost_count, hospital_consecutive_nights; prior_fracture_same_site_paid queued (tier 3)
AIG fractures 35% = 7,000 (femoral neck = leg, clause א.21); Clal fractures is a RANGE 35-100% (policy ambiguity, not a question)
turn 1: total 25,600 - 35,350; disability pending_external in both; nursing silent (adl=2 < 3)
motor/e-bike exclusions are silent (context=home), not in the checklist

scenarios.note: Same event without private sums: findings must show formulas (e.g. '35% מסכום ביטוח השברים') and list missing slots per holding.
